tests.title: The fixed test set of adding and changing sentences passes its thresholds against the fake model

steps.action: Count the sentences of the set.
steps.expected: At least 30 adding and 10 changing; both kinds have Polish and English sentences.

steps.action: Run the set against the fake model.
steps.expected: The runner reports, per sentence, whether the date and every field are right, and in total the share with the date right ≥ 95 % and the share with every field right ≥ 80 %.

tests.title: The fixed test set passes with the date right in at least 95 % and every field in at least 80 % against a real Ollama with `gemma4:e4b`

steps.action: List the models Ollama has.
steps.expected: `gemma4:e4b` is listed.

steps.action: Run the test set's hand-run test against the live Ollama.
steps.expected: The runner reports the date right in ≥ 95 % of the sentences and every field right in ≥ 80 %.

tests.title: With "Sprint planning" (Monday 10:00–11:00) open, "przesuń na 15" opens its editing at 15:00–16:00, and nothing is saved before Save

steps.action: Open the details of "Sprint planning"; press `q`, send the description.
steps.expected: The editing of "Sprint planning" opens with Monday 26 October 15:00–16:00, the title unchanged.

steps.action: Read the fake Google's record.
steps.expected: No update was sent; the week view still shows the event at 10:00.

steps.action: Save.
steps.expected: The fake Google receives one update of "Sprint planning" to 15:00–16:00; the week view shows it at 15:00.

tests.title: "przesuń spotkanie z Anią na piątek" opens that event's editing on Friday at the same time, and Save changes it without adding an event

steps.action: Press `q`, send the description.
steps.expected: The editing of "Spotkanie z Anią" opens with Friday 30 October 11:00–12:00.

steps.action: Save; read the fake Google's record.
steps.expected: One update of that event and no new event; the week shows one "Spotkanie z Anią", on Friday.

tests.title: A past event is not matched by name — "no such event", the text kept — but is changed when its details are open

steps.action: With no details open, send the first description.
steps.expected: No editing opens; the box says no such event was found and still holds the text.

steps.action: Go to the week of 19 October, open the event's details; press `q`, send the second description.
steps.expected: The editing of the 19 October event opens with Friday 30 October 11:00–12:00.

tests.title: Three matching standups are listed with title, day, time and calendar; arrows and Enter open the chosen one, and Esc returns to the description

steps.action: Press `q`, send the description.
steps.expected: Under the box in the side panel three rows are listed — the 27, 28 and 29 October standups, each with its title, day, 09:30 and "Work"; the 23 October one is not listed.

steps.action: Press Esc.
steps.expected: The list is gone; the box holds the description and has the cursor.

steps.action: Press Enter, then Down twice and Enter.
steps.expected: The editing of the Thursday 29 October standup opens with 10:00–10:15.

tests.title: Saving a described change of a series occurrence with a guest asks for the scope and whether to notify the guest

steps.action: Open the details of the 28 October occurrence; press `q`, send the description.
steps.expected: Its editing opens with 16:00–17:00.

steps.action: Save.
steps.expected: The app asks for the scope: this event, this and following, all.

steps.action: Choose "This event".
steps.expected: The app asks whether to notify the guests.

steps.action: Choose not to notify.
steps.expected: The fake Google receives a change of the 28 October occurrence only, without notifying the guests.

tests.title: A described change of an event where the user is a guest without rights, or of a read-only calendar, opens its editing locked as today

steps.action: Open the details of "Przegląd kwartalny"; press `q`, send the description.
steps.expected: Its editing opens as it does for that event without a description: the time locked at 10:00–11:00.

steps.action: Open the details of "Wszystkich Świętych"; send the description again.
steps.expected: It opens as a read-only event does today: nothing can be changed, and the app says why.

steps.action: Read the fake Google's record.
steps.expected: No change was sent.
